# EcoMind AI - Results (generated by the application)

Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Data: NASA POWER daily, 2015-01-01 to 2025-12-31
Training days: 3,652
Test year: 2025 (365 test days)

## Model comparison (held-out test year)

| Model | MAE | RMSE |
|---|---|---|
| Persistence baseline | 0.7525 | 1.0317 |
| Linear Regression | 0.6635 | 0.8904 |
| Random Forest | 0.6591 | 0.8931 |

Persistence baseline MAE: 0.7525 kWh/m2/day.
Lowest MAE: Random Forest (0.6591 kWh/m2/day).
